m.name: Clean
m.flavor: The face you were issued.

m.name: 3-Day Stubble
m.flavor: Grew it during the last outage.

m.name: Full Beard
m.flavor: Untracked by facial recognition since 2047.

m.name: Collapse Scar
m.flavor: From the war nobody streams anymore.

m.name: Rebel Warpaint
m.flavor: Breaks GigaCorp face-scan. Mostly.

m.name: Turing Circuitry
m.flavor: Lines of light where the implant went in.

m.name: Buzz Cut
m.flavor: Low maintenance. Low bandwidth.

m.name: Crew Cut
m.flavor: Regulation length, irregular attitude.

m.name: Middle-Manager Slick
m.flavor: Smells like a quarterly review.

m.name: Undercut
m.flavor: Shaved sides for the neural port.

m.name: Bob
m.flavor: Sharp enough to cut a contract.

m.name: Long Hair
m.flavor: Hasn't seen a barber since the Collapse.

m.name: Couch Shag
m.flavor: Styled by sleeping on it for a year.

m.name: Ponytail
m.flavor: Practical. Gets caught in exactly one door.

m.name: Afro
m.flavor: Volume settings: maximum.

m.name: Top Bun
m.flavor: Holds three styluses and a grudge.

m.name: Signal Mohawk
m.flavor: Doubles as an antenna. Allegedly.

m.name: Nothing
m.flavor: Let the wind decide.

m.name: Beanie
m.flavor: Standard issue for sleeping on public transit.

m.name: Backwards Cap
m.flavor: The G stands for "GigaCorp?" Nobody is sure.

m.name: Rebel Bandana
m.flavor: Tied the way the old rebels tied it.

m.name: Tinfoil Hat
m.flavor: Blocks 98% of targeted ads. The other 2% are about tinfoil.

m.name: Cat-Ear Headset
m.flavor: Streams your purring to 4 followers.

m.name: Tactical Helmet
m.flavor: Rated for bullets, rubble and bad takes.

m.name: Traffic Cone
m.flavor: The city stopped fixing roads, so the cones went free.

m.name: Data Rancher Hat
m.flavor: There will be data.

m.name: Old Money Top Hat
m.flavor: From before money was a subscription.

m.name: SEED-7 Recon Helmet
m.flavor: Full seal. Gold visor. Zero ads get in.

m.name: Founder's Crown
m.flavor: Worn by whoever owned the server you live on.

m.name: Turing Halo
m.flavor: A ring of light that hums when Turing lies.

m.flavor: Raw eyeballs. Brave.

m.name: Shades
m.flavor: Too cool to see the ads.

m.name: Ski Goggles
m.flavor: For a ski season that ended in 2031.

m.name: Couch VR
m.flavor: Reality, but with a 4.2-star rating.

m.flavor: Face-scan says: "User not found."

m.name: Cyber Visor
m.flavor: One line of light. Infinite attitude.

m.name: Monocle
m.flavor: For reading the fine print on your soul.

m.name: Smog Filter
m.flavor: The air is a premium tier now.

m.name: Disguise Kit
m.flavor: GigaCorp facial recognition hates this one trick.

m.name: Clown Nose
m.flavor: Honk if you hate late capitalism.

m.flavor: Kept you waiting, huh? Cardboard box sold separately.

m.flavor: Merch from the last outdoor festival.

m.flavor: Pockets big enough for a whole sandwich.

m.flavor: Out of office. Forever.

m.flavor: Bought with a CEO's stock options. Literally.

m.name: Turing-Slayer Exoframe

m.flavor: Ten fingers, factory default.

m.name: Fingerless Gloves
m.flavor: Keep your fingers free for typing manifestos.

m.flavor: Melee damage +0%. Style +100%.

m.flavor: For the gym you swear you'll go to.

m.flavor: Pre-ripped by the Collapse.

m.flavor: Pockets on the pockets.

m.flavor: It's always summer in the server farm.

m.flavor: Three stripes. Zero sponsors.

m.flavor: Maximum airflow, maximum menace.

m.flavor: Mismatched on purpose. Probably.

m.name: Sneakers

m.flavor: Fashion is a construct. So is GigaCorp.

m.flavor: Honk. Honk. Honk.

m.flavor: Solid gold, solid flex.

m.flavor: Travel light.

m.name: Go-Bag
m.flavor: Snacks, bandages, a spare personality.

m.flavor: Picks up three stations and your neighbour's fridge.

m.flavor: Knows one song. It's about GigaCorp.

m.name: Katana
m.flavor: Decorative. Absolutely not decorative.

m.name: Rebel Cape
m.flavor: Dramatic exits included.

m.name: Couch Cushion
m.flavor: Was a Couch Surfer's home. Now it's yours.

m.name: Jump Jet
m.flavor: Cosmetic thrusters. Very convincing.

m.name: Server Rack
m.flavor: Your own data, on your own back. The most rebellious item in the game.

m.name: Glitch Wings
m.flavor: Rendered by Turing as an apology. It was not sincere.

m.flavor: A neck. Unadorned.

m.name: GigaCorp Lanyard
m.flavor: "VISITOR". Always a visitor.

m.name: Neck Headphones
m.flavor: Noise-cancelling. Propaganda-cancelling.

m.name: Scarf
m.flavor: Knitted by a Serverless grandma. She remembers you.

m.name: Shell Bandolier
m.flavor: Riptide rounds, worn with pride.

m.flavor: Real gold. Probably. Don't test it.

m.name: Crypto Bling
m.flavor: Worth a fortune on Tuesday. Worth a sandwich on Wednesday.

rules.nodes: a kit GLB holds '<item>@<bone>' nodes (hidden, scale 0): clone them onto the base's bone of that name, scale 1
rules.replaces: 'b_*' entries hide that base body segment; bare bone names (forearm_R) hide pieces on that bone from items of a lower-priority category
rules.hair: headgear.hair: 'all' shows any hair, 'short' only hair with length 'short', 'none' no hair (the buzz scalp stays); hats with a cut tuck away 'tall' hair
rules.hat_fit: headgear.cut [yf, yb]: clip the hair kit above the plane through (y=yf, z=.1) and (y=yb, z=-.1) in rest-pose body space (convert once into the head bone's rest space, then follow the head every frame; needs renderer.localClippingEnabled). headgear.fit {hairId: s}: scale that hat's x/z by s so the band sits on the worn hair. headgear.clear: lift the hat by max(0, hair.top + .015 - clear).
rules.blocks: an item that blocks a category hides whatever is worn in it (a sealed helmet blocks face gear)
rules.tint: texel *= palette tint of slots[mask / 32] for every kit texture, albedo and emissive
rules.first_person: hide every node under the head bone; the arms (forearm/hand pieces) are the viewmodel arms and the legs/feet stay visible
